column10: New Commander precon (Aetherdrift: Eternal Might) released Jan 2025 with Hashaton, Scarab's Fist as face commander. Varina is the premier upgrade pick for Zombie/discard synergies. The Command Zone highlighted her on their podcast.
column13: MTGRocks article (Jan 29, 2025), Wargamer article (Feb 3, 2025), Cardsphere blog (Jan 31, 2025)

column10: Final Fantasy XIV Commander precon (June 2025) introduced Y'shtola, Night's Blessed. Slaughter's buyback cost of 4 life triggers Y'shtola's draw ability each time it's cast, making it a repeatable draw-and-remove engine. Only 1 printing (Exodus, 1998), extremely low supply.

MTG Final Fantasy Counter Blitz precon (June 2025) flooded the board with +1/+1 counters. Spike Cannibal, which steals ALL +1/+1 counters from all creatures on ETB, became a tech anti-Counter-Blitz card AND a combo piece. Spike didn't gain value until mid-July — a lag spike as players discovered the interaction.
column11: New Commander Precon (hate card discovery, delayed)

column10: Duskmourn: House of Horror Commander precons (Sept 2024) included Aminatou as face commander. Zur's ability to animate high-mana-value enchantments synergizes perfectly with Room cards. Also saw play in Marina Vendrell 5-color Room decks and minor Standard play.

Duskmourn Commander precons (Sept 2024) included strong Dimir (U/B) commanders. Tainted Isle is a conditional dual land (produces U or B if you control a Swamp) — a cheap, efficient mana fixer for any Dimir deck. Wilds of Eldraine Commander printing was the cheapest version and emptied first.
column13: Inferred from Duskmourn Dimir commander context and land demand timing.

column10: Outlaws of Thunder Junction precon (Apr 2024) included Ghostly Pilferer in the 'stealing spells' deck. Its ability to draw cards whenever opponents cast from non-hand sources makes it ideal for Dimir theft decks. As players built around new OTJ commanders like Gonti, demand for the Pilferer from the same precon's reprint spiked.
column13: OTJ Commander decklist (Apr 2024) confirmed inclusion. No dedicated spike article found.

column10: Lorwyn Eclipsed Commander precon 'Blight Curse' revealed December 2025; Atomize synergizes with the Blight mechanic (-1/-1 counters) introduced by High Perfect Morcant. Players bought Atomize as a precon upgrade before the deck released.

Duskmourn: House of Horror Commander precon 'Endless Punishment' (Valgavoth, Harrower of Souls) released September 2024. Chandra's emblems deal damage each upkeep — they stack, can't be countered, and can't be removed, making her a premier finisher for Valgavoth's group-slug strategy. Also saw sideboard play in Pioneer Boros.

column3: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
column10: Duskmourn Commander precon 'Endless Punishment' (Valgavoth, Harrower of Souls) released September 2024. Ob Nixilis triggers whenever an opponent loses exactly 1 life — synergizing with every chip-damage effect. March of the Machine: The Aftermath was a poorly-received mini-set with very low supply, making mythics especially scarce.

Aetherdrift Commander precon 'Eternal Might' (Temmet, Naktamun's Will) revealed January 2025. Unfulfilled Desires (pay 1 mana: discard, then draw) is ideal for Temmet's discard/graveyard synergies. The Command Zone highlighted it in a YouTube Short viewed by 17,000+ people, calling it underpriced. Reserved List card — will never be reprinted.
Same Duskmourn Commander precon synergy as rank #8 (Showcase version). Non-showcase Dominaria United version spiked proportionally, with the base version having less speculative premium baked in.

Same Duskmourn/Valgavoth Commander spike as rank #24. Commander Masters is a premium set with relatively low print run for individual cards — supply dried up quickly alongside the Core Set 2020 version.

Duskmourn Commander precon 'Miracle Worker' (Aminatou, Veil Protector) revealed at PAX August 2024. Penance lets you put cards from hand on top of library at will — enabling Miracle triggers cheaply and repeatedly. Price began rising on Aminatou's PAX reveal before full decklists were published.

Edge of Eternities Commander precon 'Counter Intelligence' (August 2025) was revealed without reprinting Filigree Vector. The card distributes charge counters and +1/+1 counters across your board, making it the premier upgrade for the charge-counter-themed precon. Only printed in the March of the Machine Commander set.
column13: MTGRocks (Filigree Vector 431% spike), Draftsim (charge counter precon spike)

column10: Infantry Shield was included in one of the Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander precon decks (Jeskai Warrior token strategy, released April 2025). Its equipped creature gains menace and creates attacking Warrior tokens equal to its power. Post-release demand for the included reprint drove the price as players upgraded their decks.
column13: MTGGoldfish price history; MTGPrice early Tarkir Dragonstorm movers article (Apr 12, 2025). No dedicated spike article found.

column10: Lorwyn Eclipsed Commander precon 'Blight Curse' revealed January 2026 without reprinting Persistent Constrictor. This Duskmourn Commander card distributes -1/-1 counters to all opponent creatures whenever it attacks, making it the premier upgrade for the Blight Curse deck. Same demand wave as Atomize (#21) and Crumbling Ashes (#98).
column13: MTGRocks (Persistent Constrictor 800% spike Jan 2026), Draftsim (weekly spikes Jan 3-9)

column10: Lorwyn Eclipsed Commander precon decklists revealed January 2026 featured Ashling, the Limitless (Elemental Evoke commander). Life Finds a Way creates non-exile token copies of Evoked Elementals, letting them persist permanently. Card only appears in 1 out of every 12 Lost Caverns of Ixalan set boosters — extremely scarce supply.
column13: MTGRocks (Life Finds a Way 418% Lorwyn Eclipsed spike)

column10: Three converging factors: (1) Amazon Prime Fallout TV Show Season 2 hype driving speculators; (2) Strong Jund-colors proliferate ability ideal for the new Lorwyn Eclipsed 'Blight Curse' Commander precon; (3) Over 500 copies sold on January 2 in what appears to be a coordinated buyout. Extended Art version spiked alongside the base.

column10: Final Fantasy Commander (June 2025) introduced Y'shtola, Night's Blessed. Vile Consumption forces opponents to pay 1B each upkeep per nonblack creature they control or those creatures die — triggering Y'shtola's 'draw when opponents pay 4+ life' ability. Only printed in Invasion (2000), making NM copies extremely scarce.

column10: Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander (April 2025) included Legion Warboss in a Goblin/warrior-themed precon, and/or created demand for the card as a precon upgrade. Warboss creates a tapped, attacking Goblin token every combat — a powerful engine in any aggro or Goblin Commander deck.
column13: Inferred from Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander release timing. No dedicated article found.

column10: Edge of Eternities (August 2025) Commander precon 'World Shaper' featured Eumidian alien insects with landfall synergies. Zask mills the top card and casts Insect spells from exile for free, synergizing with the insect-swarm World Shaper deck. Only printed in Jumpstart 2022, causing an extreme supply crunch.
column13: MTGRocks (Zask 406% spike due to Edge of Eternities precon), Wargamer (Zask 600% alien bugs spike)

column10: Same Edge of Eternities 'Counter Intelligence' precon spike as rank #54 (Extended Art version). Base version and Extended Art spiked together once the precon decklist confirmed Filigree Vector was not reprinted.
column13: MTGRocks (Filigree Vector 431% spike), Draftsim (charge counter precon spike)

column10: Same Lorwyn Eclipsed 'Blight Curse' precon demand wave as ranks #21, #57, #67, #68. Crumbling Ashes destroys each creature with a -1/-1 counter at end of turn — an automatic, repeatable kill engine in a -1/-1 counter deck. Only printed in Eventide (2008) with near-mint copies extremely scarce. Over 50 copies sold in three days following the January 11 reveal.
column13: MTGRocks (Crumbling Ashes 395% Lorwyn Eclipsed spike), Wargamer (Crumbling Ashes 575% spike)

column10: Tarkir: Dragonstorm (April 2025) Commander precon featured Teval, the Balanced Scale — a Sultai Commander that creates Zombie Druid tokens whenever cards leave the graveyard. Seton lets you tap any Druid for G mana, turning Teval's tokens into an explosive mana engine. Never reprinted since Odyssey (2001); price rose from $0.90 to $9.10+ in about one week.
column13: MTGRocks (Seton 1067% centaur druid spike), Wargamer (Seton 700% spike)
